text:
maya (ml): Kicking off qbridge-4b -> qbridge-4b-int4 bring-up. Key blockers: curated micro-golden, prune rules for boilerplate, and quant-compat eval harness. Found ~2.9% overlap after fuzzy dedupe.

rahul (curation): Overlap looks long-tail. Mostly short snippets + stack traces. Proposal: retain all items with unique annotated failures; auto-prune high-frequency exact duplicates.

lee (label ops): Capacity: we can handle 600 manual relabels this sprint if shipped as 150/day batches. Prefer CSV export with provenance + cluster_id.

otto (prod-mle): Gates: run int4 vs fp16 on the micro-golden and measure: top-1 delta, calibration drift (Brier), and hallucination token rate. Abort if top-1 drops >0.7% or hallucination +0.6pp.

maya (ml): Micro-golden plan: 500 verified golden, 600 edgecases for relabel, 300 rare-tail samples. rahul will deliver list in 36h. auto-prune rule: cluster_size>8 and token_len<22 -> keep 2 reps; else flag.

rahul (curation): Will export CSV with cols: id,prompt,prev_label,cluster_id,sha256. Excluding PII-tagged prompts. ETA 36h.

lee (label ops): We will relabel edgecases first. Note: please mark examples with long context separately; those need full-label passes.

canary-bot: Checklist created and assigned: curation:rahul, labels:lee, eval:otto/maya. Offline sim scheduled 02:00 UTC.

maya (ml): I'll post the eval scripts (tokenizer v2 parity) and the initial sim results in this thread. If sim passes, microcanary at 5% traffic with immediate rollback to fp16 fallback.

otto (prod-mle): Also collect reranker delta distribution (not just mean). We'll check tail regressions.

rahul (curation): Quick question: do we treat prompts that only differ by whitespace as duplicates? I vote yes for auto collapse.

maya (ml): Yes collapse whitespace-only variants; keep provenance tag and origin.

lee (label ops): Ack. We'll prep labeler queues once CSV lands.

canary-bot: Offline sim job started (job_id: sim-6133334444). Results will be posted on completion.
